question: O'Neil/Ryan caution that late-stage bases (far above the 52-week low) fail more -- expect HIGHER pct_52wl to show WORSE (or flat) stop-R than a stock closer to its 52-week low on burst events
plain: O'Neil and Ryan warn that a stock already way above its 52-week low is more likely in a late, tired stage of its move. This checks if breakouts from stocks far above their yearly low do worse than ones closer to it.
